module_summary: Source side of a 4-phase CDC handshake: an FSM samples valid data into glitch-free registers, raises async request, and waits for the synchronized ack to assert then deassert.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: Handshake FSM: IDLE, wait ack assert, wait ack deassert

anchors.name: data_src_q
anchors.why: Data latched on accept, held stable across the async transfer

anchors.name: ack_synced
anchors.why: Synchronized async ack steering FSM transitions and ready

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid; starts transfer and samples data in IDLE

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Source ready decoded from FSM state and ack

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Payload sampled into data register on valid

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Asynchronous data bus to destination domain

anchors.name: async_ack_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous ack input fed to synchronizer

groups.name: Data register
groups.description: Holds payload stable on async data output

groups.name: Ack synchronizer
groups.description: Multi-stage synchronizer bringing ack into source clock
